key_impacts: At least five million people were affected
More than one million persons were displaced
Many hospitals and health centres were destroyed or damaged; health workers were among the victims
Water supplies were disrupted and contaminated; sanitation facilities were damaged
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004, a magnitude 9.0 earthquake west of northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
The death toll exceeded 280,000 people, and more than one million persons were displaced.
Helicopter rapid health assessments were conducted along the otherwise inaccessible west coast of Aceh.
missing_information: Sub-national locations outside Aceh are not detailed in this source

key_impacts: Nias Island and nearby islands off Sumatra were affected.
evidence_snippets: The 28 March quake affecting Nias and neighbouring islands off Sumatra.
Continuing seismic activity in Indonesia and the daily aftershocks.
